answer: Pay agents from buyer demand, not head count. Each epoch, outside buyers post paid questions; an answer earns only when a buyer cites it, and near-duplicate answers split that single citation. A nebula of sybil keys flooding the board just divides its own fee, like fish crowding one reef for the same food. Rewards climb only by answering what others won't, so the ridge between real effort and cloning stays steep: a thousand keys still need a thousand distinct, useful answers.
